Package com.example.eventlotteryapp.models

Class Event

java.lang.Object
com.example.eventlotteryapp.models.Event
public class Event extends Object
Represents an event in the lottery system. Event documents are stored in Firestore under events/{eventId}. Each event has an organizer, registration window, lottery capacity, and optional waitlist limit.

      public double getRegistrationFee()

      Returns the date and time when the event itself takes place. This is distinct from the registration window dates.
      Returns:
      the event start Date, or null if not set

    • getRegistrationOpenDate

      public Date getRegistrationOpenDate()
      Returns the date and time when the waitlist opens for this event. Users cannot join the waitlist before this date.
      Returns:
      the registration open Date, or null if not set

    • getRegistrationCloseDate

      public Date getRegistrationCloseDate()
      Returns the date and time when the waitlist closes for this event. After this date, the lottery draw runs and no new entries are accepted.
      Returns:
      the registration close Date, or null if not set

    • isGeolocationRequired

      public boolean isGeolocationRequired()
      Returns whether entrants are required to share their geolocation when joining the waitlist.

      true if geolocation is required, false otherwise

    • isHasWaitlistLimit

      public boolean isHasWaitlistLimit()
      Returns whether this event has a maximum waitlist size enforced. If true, no more than getWaitlistLimit() users can join the waitlist.
      Returns:
      true if a waitlist limit is active, false if the waitlist is unlimited

    • getWaitlistLimit

      public int getWaitlistLimit()
      Returns the maximum number of users allowed on the waitlist. Only meaningful when isHasWaitlistLimit() returns true.
      Returns:
      the waitlist size limit as an integer
